action: Add action-gate checks and documentation so written rules, user feedback, security, Ryunosuke evaluation, Raphael behavior, approval boundaries, communication, delivery acceptance, recovery, agent design, state sync, quality validation, and tool authority must be converted into action checks before AURA repair resumes.
classification_basis: Ryunosuke reported that prior work repeatedly read rules without applying them and required prevention mechanisms before AURA fixes.

evidence.result: Ryunosuke required all written-but-not-applied rule areas to be checked, not only the latest example.

applicable_rules: AURA本人受入評価を修正の起点にする
だめだった点をすべて修正できる状態でAURA修正へ進む
ユーザーの例示を表面的な修正項目だけに縮小しない
初心者にも分かる説明へ変換する
セキュリティ、評価方法、Raphael行動規範などの正本領域を行動前に照合する
内部検証と本人受入を分離する
GitHub連携で実行可能な作業を進める

prevention_controls: Require feedback underlying issue and interpretation risk
